name: Fallen in the Fen

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the grief of losing a brother to ancient digs and untamed wilderness. You know crafted metal can outlive the hand meant to hold it.
As a blacksmith, you understand the care Dorin put into arms meant as a surprise for his kin. Now the gear recalls his brother’s untimely death.
As an Alliance traveler, you can bring comfort to a grieving artisan in Redridge. A town resident seeks closure during troubled times for the kingdom.

aliases: what is fallen in the fen
faq.answer: At the excavation sites, you find a fallen dwarf and cover his body with his own cloak. Then you carry word of his fate to his grieving brother, Dorin Songblade, in Lakeshire.
faq.q: What is Fallen in the Fen?

faq.answer: Dorin Songblade is a dwarven smith in Lakeshire. He had been forging a surprise set of gear for his brother when he learned of the death at the excavation sites.

aliases: whose body is in the excavation
faq.answer: The fallen dwarf was Dorin Songblade’s brother. Before his expedition, he passed through Lakeshire to gather supplies, then met his death in the field.
faq.q: Who is the fallen dwarf found at the excavation?

faq.answer: Dorin Songblade lives in Lakeshire, the primary settlement in the Redridge Mountains. He works at the forge there.
faq.q: Where can Dorin Songblade be found?

faq.answer: Dorin was forging equipment as a surprise gift for his brother. The work was unfinished when his brother left on his expedition. Dorin cannot bear to keep, reforge, or sell the gear.
faq.q: What was Dorin forging for his brother?

aliases: why did dorin give away the gear
why does dorin give you equipment
faq.answer: Dorin regrets not accompanying his brother and cannot bear to keep, reforge, or sell the arms he made. He gives the finished pieces to the traveler who brought news of his kin.
faq.q: Why does Dorin give away the items he crafted?

sections.body: At the excavation sites, an adventurous dwarf lies dead. You cover his remains with his own cloak, then carry the grim news to Lakeshire and seek out his kin.
sections.title: Tragedy at the Dig

sections.body:
Dorin Songblade is a dwarven craftsman in Lakeshire. When he learns his brother's fate, grief overwhelms him. For weeks, he worked at his forge on a surprise set of gear, but it was not ready before his brother's expedition. He regrets not going with him.

Dorin cannot bear to reforge, sell, or keep what he made with his own hands. So he gives the finished pieces to the one who brought him closure.
sections.title: A Brother's Grief

summary: At the excavation, a fallen dwarf leaves grim news for his brother in Lakeshire. Dorin Songblade learns what became of his kin and faces the gifts he could not finish in time.
attribution: In-game quest text: Fallen in the Fen
